## YAML storage for tinydb alongside JSONStorage (2026-11-04)

On 2026-11-04 the owner asked for a YAML storage next to JSONStorage so the ops team can hand-edit tinydb files. They asked for a look at how the existing storages are put together and a proposed approach, including which YAML library and loader to use. They said not to write it yet.

Memory holds no observations for this conversation. Nothing has been built, merged or shipped, and no work has stalled or been reworked. The request is in the exploring and planning stage (10%), waiting on a design proposal.

What this shows so far: the owner wants to agree on a design before any code is written. Later chapters will cover the build and its release once there is dated evidence.
